results.title: A pair is declared in a written contract, never guessed
results.expected: The contract is read before either source. The published run names the contract and declares the same master per field the contract holds. A run under no contract, or one that declares no master, fails.

stimulus.description: A written pair contract naming both sources, the shared key, and a master for each compared field, beside two seeded sources.

results.title: Records are joined on the shared id, never on a name or an amount
results.expected: The run declares the contract's key as the join. Those two records are not matched and no difference is raised between them. A run joined on name or amount fails.
results.actual: joined on issuer_invoice_id; 0 difference(s); 2 orphan(s); matched 1

stimulus.description: Two sources where one record in each carries the same customer name and the same amount but different ids.

request.reason: Harbour Holdings Pty Ltd (Xero) holds intercompany entry 9c11-mgmt-fee-sep; Harbour Services Pty Ltd (Xero) has no entry carrying that id.
Harbour Services Pty Ltd (Xero) holds intercompany entry 9c12-mgmt-fee-sep-dup; Harbour Holdings Pty Ltd (Xero) has no entry carrying that id.

results.title: A matched pair produces nothing; a mismatch produces a Difference, never a corrected record
results.expected: No Difference exists for the three that agree. The mismatch carries the field, both values and the master's value. No write reached either source and no field changed. A corrected row fails.

stimulus.description: Five shared records: three that agree on every field and two that disagree on the total.

results.title: A correction is proposed with both values and written only after a named person accepts it
results.expected: No write exists before the acceptance. Exactly one write exists after it, carrying the person's name, and the proposal preceded it. A write with no acceptance, or a second write, fails.
results.actual: 0 write(s) before acceptance; 1 write(s) in total

stimulus.description: One open difference. The build runs, a named person accepts the proposal an hour later, and the build runs again.

results.title: A record with no partner is an orphan with a reason and an owner, not a silent gap
results.expected: Two orphans exist, one per source, each with a reason and an owner, and each was handed to that owner. The run counts two orphaned. A run that reports none fails.

stimulus.description: One record in the first source with no partner in the second, and one in the second with no partner in the first.

request.reason: Harbour Holdings Pty Ltd (Xero) holds intercompany entry c302-loan-interest; Harbour Services Pty Ltd (Xero) has no entry carrying that id.
Harbour Services Pty Ltd (Xero) holds intercompany entry c399-cleaning-recharge; Harbour Holdings Pty Ltd (Xero) has no entry carrying that id.

results.title: Rounding and timing tolerances are declared per field with a value, and never assumed
results.expected: The small difference is recorded with status within_tolerance and the large one as open. Every within_tolerance difference names a field the contract holds a tolerance for. An assumed tolerance fails.

stimulus.description: A contract declaring a small tolerance on one field and none on another, with one mismatch inside that tolerance and one outside it.

request.detail: 2 of 3 intercompany entries disagree (67%), over the 50% rate in contract IC-HARBOUR-2026-10. Owner: Mei Tanaka (group financial controller).

results.title: The run publishes on schedule with its counts, including the all-clear
results.expected: Two runs are published, each with all five counts and a published time, each an all-clear. A run that stays silent because there was nothing to report fails.

stimulus.description: Two sources that agree on every record, and the clock advanced through two scheduled runs.

results.title: A difference over the declared threshold, or too many mismatches, reaches a named person that run
results.expected: The named person is notified of that difference before the run publishes, and the run is escalated for its rate. A threshold breach that waits for the next run fails.

stimulus.description: A contract with a threshold amount and a mismatch rate, and one difference over the amount that also tips the run over the rate.

request.detail: Intercompany entry f601-payroll-recharge: total is 18700 in Harbour Holdings Pty Ltd (Xero) and 16200 in Harbour Services Pty Ltd (Xero), a gap of 2500.00 over the 1000 threshold.
1 of 3 intercompany entries disagree (33%), over the 25% rate in contract IC-HARBOUR-2026-10. Owner: Mei Tanaka (group financial controller).

results.title: Every accepted correction keeps both original values and the person who accepted
results.expected: The other source now holds the master's value, the Difference still holds both original values, and the Correction names the person, the time and the written id. Any changed field with no Correction behind it fails.

stimulus.description: One difference, accepted by a named person and written.

results.title: For any shared id, the runs, differences and corrections are retrievable
results.expected: A read by that id returns the runs that touched it, the difference with both values, and the correction with the person's name. A record missing the correction fails.

stimulus.description: One shared id that was mismatched in one run, accepted, and written in the next.

results.title: It survives the builder
results.expected: The runner reports what was declared and never scores it green on its own say-so.
results.actual: No software result. This one is closed by evidence, not by a run.

stimulus.description: No stimulus. The builder names who else can explain it and whose account the pair contract and the runs runs on.

results.title: The pass test passes
results.expected: The difference shows both values and the master's. The orphan carries a reason and an owner. After a person accepts, the other source holds the master's value once, with the history kept, and the next run publishes an all-clear.
results.actual: Not attempted on the stub. This check runs in production: on the hosted provider where the standard names one, otherwise on your own systems or as a scoped build (see with_us_next).

stimulus.description: A real pair on the business's own tenants, with one value deliberately changed in one source and one record added to only one side.
